text: The outage at Ruvenna’s main data centre last spring was caused by a software update error, according to an internal incident report obtained by The Continental Record and a statement from the company’s chief technology officer, Mara Ellin. The report says a routine patch deployed on April 17 propagated a faulty configuration file to 14 core servers, triggering a cascading shutdown of storage and authentication systems. Service was restored after 6 hours and 22 minutes, but not before affecting an estimated 2.8 million users across the country. Ruvenna initially attributed the disruption to “network instability,” but later acknowledged the update failure in a memo to regulators filed on May 3.
